leads.title: Crimes Act 2013 (Tulafono o Solitulafono 2013), Sections 67, 68, 71
leads.documents: Current criminalization of sodomy, attempts to commit sodomy, and keeping place of resort for homosexual acts; punishable by up to 5-7 years imprisonment; also prohibits heterosexual anal intercourse and oral sex.
leads.detail: Cited as Sections 67, 68, and 71; Act took effect on 1 May 2013; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Police v Poi (2007)
leads.documents: Court ruling defining 'Sodomy' for purposes of criminal law.
leads.detail: 2007 case cited as defining sodomy as 'penetration of the male or female victim's anus by the offender's penis'; no URL visible

leads.title: Samoa Law Reform Commission Report to the Prime Minister - June 2010
leads.documents: Government law-reform recommendation to repeal all criminal penalties for sodomy and related acts in private between consenting adult males, noting majority public submission support; Government rejected recommendation and 2011 decriminalization proposal under new Criminal Code.
leads.detail: Dated June 2010; quoted recommendation to repeal; no URL visible

leads.title: Crimes Ordinance 1961 (repealed) - Sections 58D, 58E, 58G, 58J and female-impersonation provisions
leads.documents: Former law criminalizing same-sex sexual acts and criminalizing males 'impersonating' females in a public place, used to target transgender women and gender-diverse people; repealed 1 May 2013 by Crimes Act 2013.
leads.detail: Cited as now-repealed predecessor to Crimes Act 2013; no URL visible

leads.title: Labour and Employment Relations Act 2013 (Tulafono o Sootaga Va Lelei o Leipa ma Galuega 2013), Section 20(2) / Article 20
leads.documents: Limited employment discrimination protection prohibiting direct and indirect discrimination on basis of sexual orientation against employee or applicant.
leads.detail: Quoted Article 20 list including sexual orientation; no URL visible

leads.title: Sentencing Act 2016 (Tulafono o Faasalaga 2016), Section 7(1)(h)
leads.documents: Criminal-sentencing provision covering crimes motivated by sexual orientation or gender identity.
leads.detail: Cited as Section 7(1)(h); no URL visible

leads.title: Mental Health Act 2007 (Tulafono o le Tulaga Maloloina o le Mafaufau 2007)
leads.documents: Provides people are not to be considered mentally ill if they refuse or fail to express a particular sexual orientation, and prohibits conversion therapy by health professionals in mental health field.

leads.title: Ombudsman / National Human Rights Institution (NHRI) - First National State of Human Rights Report, August 2015 and 'For Samoa by Samoa' overview; Ombudsman (Komesina O Sulufaiga) Act 2013
leads.documents: Institutional rights machinery: NHRI launched 10 September 2013; 2015 report refers to fa'afafine as 'the third gender that has always existed in Samoa' and notes family roles; first overview 'For Samoa by Samoa' makes no mention of sexual orientation and gender identity despite LGBTQ presence on Advisory Council.
leads.detail: NHRI launch date 10 September 2013; report release August 2015; no URL visible

leads.title: United Nations Human Rights Council - Universal Periodic Review (UPR) Working Group on Samoa, First and Second cycle (Third cycle due April-May 2021) and 2011 Joint Statement on SOGI
leads.documents: International human-rights review: First cycle Samoa rejected level 5 recommendations by Canada, France, Norway to repeal criminalization and investigate SOGI discrimination, accepted US recommendation to continue reconsideration; Second cycle accepted only Slovenia recommendation to reduce violence based on sexual orientation and gender identity, rejected others on cultural sensitivity/Christian Constitution grounds; 2011 Samoa signed joint statement on ending acts of violence and related human rights violations based on sexual orientation and gender identity.
leads.detail: UPR mechanism cited; third cycle due April and May 2021; 2011 joint statement title quoted; no URL visible

leads.title: Samoa Censorship Board bans - Milk (2009) and Rocketman (2019)
leads.documents: Documented enforcement/censorship incidents: 2009 ban on screening Milk about Harvey Milk while allowing Lesbian Vampire Killers same week; 2019 ban on Rocketman about Elton John; criticized as hypocritical/selective morality and protested by Samoa Fa'afafine Association.
leads.detail: Years 2009 and 2019 cited; Samoa Fa'afafine Association protest noted; no URL visible
